issues.description: The problem specification and UML require Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return a String containing the message "[Animal Type] [name] is milked", but the solution repository defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return a boolean and the Goat/Seal implementations print the message to stdout and return true. This contradicts the required method return type and behavior and would confuse students (and tests) that expect a String return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem specification: change the Milkable interface to declare String messageOnMilk(); then update Goat and Seal to return the String message "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (do not only print it). Alternatively, if the boolean return was intended, update the problem statement and UML to specify a boolean return and adjust examples/tests accordingly. Prefer changing the solution to return String to match the specification.
